57 . Elevation The highest elevation in the United States is Mount McKinley, Alaska, at $20,320 \text{feet}$ above sea level. The lowest elevation is Death Valley, California, at $282 \text{feet}$ below sea level. Use integers to write the elevation of: ⓐ Mount McKinley ⓑ Death Valley

58 . Extreme temperatures The highest recorded temperature on Earth is $\text{57}°\text{ Celsius}$ . The lowest recorded temperature is $\text{90}°$ below $\text{0}°\text{ Celsius}$ . Use integers to write the: ⓐ highest recorded temperature ⓑ lowest recorded temperature

59 . State budgets In June, 2011, the state of Pennsylvania estimated it would have a budget surplus of $\$\text{540 million}.$ That same month, Texas estimated it would have a budget deficit of $\$\text{27 billion}.$ Use integers to write the budget: ⓐ surplus ⓑ deficit

60 . College enrollments Across the United States, community college enrollment grew by $1,400,000$ students from $2007$ to $2010 .$ In California, community college enrollment declined by $110,171$ students from $2009$ to $2010 .$ Use integers to write the change in enrollment: ⓐ growth ⓑ decline
